long_biography.plain_text:
By 1994, Glenn Markus was president of Allsteel & Gypsum Products, a South Florida supplier serving the construction trade. More than three decades later, he remains the company's registered president and leads associated international-sales and export businesses.

Allsteel combines manufacturing with distribution. It produces light-gauge and structural steel framing, including cut-to-length studs and joists, and supplies gypsum board, insulation, lumber and masonry products. Markus is also a managing member of Markus Steel, linking his corporate role to a separate steel-focused entity. The group serves residential, commercial and industrial customers from locations in Fort Lauderdale and Miami.
